description: The account's games, projects and campaigns (kind: game, project or campaign; a project is the same thing for anything that is not a game, a campaign is the same thing for a tabletop RPG table) with how much is in each (entities, events and generated sounds; a game can have every sound in folder events and no entity), the credit balance and the prices: account.creditsPerSecond for sounds, account.music.creditsPerMinute per quality level for tracks (cost = seconds × that ÷ 60, rounded up). Each game has its page on the site (url): when you mention a game, give the user its link. Read-only, costs nothing. Call it at the start to find the game id the other tools need and to see the balance before quoting a cost; for what is inside one game, use get_game.
name: list_games

creditsPerMinute.description: Quality level => credits per minute of music (only levels available now).

title: List games
